1.4.0: Follows Buggregator 2.9.0: connects the JavaScript, Python and Go Sentry SDKs too, each with a test event; a browser DSN goes into dev builds only.
Says Buggregator is prepared for the MCP Registry but not listed there yet, and uses Docker tag 2.9.0.
1.3.0: Follows Buggregator 2.8.0: reads Xdebug function traces with the 4 new MCP tools; records and uploads them only from dev apps on your OK.
Says at setup that Buggregator now asks GitHub for new releases, and offers to turn that check off.
Knows the VarDumper link that opens a dump's source in your editor, and Docker tag 2.8.0.
1.2.0: Follows Buggregator 2.7.0: without an IDE it can drive a paused PHP request, stepping or stopping it only on your OK for each action.
Saved breakpoints and the 7 new Xdebug MCP tools; it says control is on by default and offers a read-only switch, and lists breakpoints at the end.
Knows the mock editor and JSON-only OpenAPI import, Docker tag 2.7.0, the container memory limit and Ray chained calls in one event.
1.1.0: Follows Buggregator 2.6.0: the Xdebug proxy and the mock server are in a release now, marked since 2.6.0.
Works mocks over MCP with the 11 new mock tools; each rule change waits for your OK, and MCP_MOCK_WRITE=false makes them read-only.
Knows the install script (shown before it runs), Windows ARM64, Docker tag 2.6.0, the new Sentry filters and the SSO token on module APIs.
1.0.0: First version: runs Buggregator for your local development, starting it with your OK and keeping every port on 127.0.0.1.
Connects your app's SDKs module by module, gives your agent the events over MCP, and reads test mail and one-time codes for end-to-end tests.
Xdebug proxy and mock server: included, and each needs the next Buggregator release or a master build.
